channel.title: Open-Weights on Best of AI
channel.description: Recent content in Open-Weights on Best of AI

item.title: AstaBrief 8B
item.description: AstaBrief 8B turns a research question and a set of papers into a cited report. Ai2 also added a Fast mode in Asta that uses it.

item.title: Beam
item.description: Beam is Reflection’s open sparse mixture-of-experts model, with 501B total and 23B active parameters under Apache 2.0. It is built for coding, reasoning, and agentic work.

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
item.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 puts text, code, image, video, and audio into one embedding space. It has 740M parameters and is small enough to run on-device.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
item.description: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 23, 2026. It is a 3T-class model with a 1M-token context window, aimed at coding, 3D, financial research, and agentic tasks. A faster Highspeed variant launched the same day.

item.title: Kolibri
item.description: Kolibri is Aleph Alpha’s open mixture-of-experts model for English and German, with 78B total and 3B active parameters and up to 1M tokens of context. It is aimed at regulated work.

item.title: LFM3
item.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s new model family built on a shared backbone. The first release is six 2B-class models covering text, vision, audio, omni, and decision tasks.

item.title: Ling-3.1-flash
item.description: Ling-3.1-flash is a hybrid reasoning model from InclusionAI with 560B total and about 25B active parameters and a 1M-token context. It targets agent, search, office, and coding tasks.

item.title: Mellum2.1
item.description: JetBrains released Mellum2.1 on October 8, 2026, an open 12B mixture-of-experts model for coding agents. It was trained with reinforcement learning in coding environments.

item.title: Muse Spark Open
item.description: Muse Spark Open is a natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta, with 816B total and 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. It targets coding and agentic work.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
item.description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B is a small model that fits in 4GB, built for conversational agents with multi-turn tool use and configurable reasoning. It has a 64K context window.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
item.description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe follows instructions for transcription, translation, and speaker attribution across 40 languages, and handles recordings up to an hour long.

item.title: Qwen3.6 27B
item.description: Qwen3.6 27B is a 27B-parameter model from Alibaba’s Qwen team, released October 21, 2026.

item.title: WeVisOne-VL
item.description: WeVisOne-VL is a vision-language model from Tencent in 2B and 4B sizes. It handles detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting.
